value: **Involvement**: Teachers actively participated in collaborative co-design workshops, design meetings, or teacher communities with researchers to iteratively develop, test, and adapt curriculum units, assessments, and lesson plans. **Evidence**: "Moreover, NMP emphasizes iterative and cyclic co-design processes, in which students and teachers collectively generate an epistemic environment that affords learning and action (Markauskaite & Goodyear, 2016)."
